shots.name: proposed-buttons-narrow
shots.expect: js:document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-block]')?.dataset.planStatus === 'proposed' && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-block] button')].some(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Approve') && !document.body.textContent.includes('SESSIONS IN THIS WINDOW') && !document.body.textContent.includes('Sessions in this window') && [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ceiling] button')].map(b=>b.textContent.trim()).join('|') === 'Comment|Approve' && (()=>{const row=document.querySelector('[data-testid=plan-ceiling]').getBoundingClientRect(), a=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=plan-ceiling] button')].pop().getBoundingClientRect(); return a.right <= row.right + 1 && a.right > row.right - 4})()
